title: Kunxian capsule alleviates renal damage by inhibiting the JAK1/STAT1 pathway in lupus nephritis.
authors: Cheng, Chen; Zhu, Rongrong; Liu, Mingjian; Yang, Hao; Guo, Fangfang; Du, Qunqun; Wang, Xiaolan; Li, Minmin; Song, Gaopeng; Qin, Renan; Liu, Shuwen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究昆仙胶囊通过JAK1/STAT1通路缓解狼疮性肾炎，仅涉及分子对接且非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Kunxian capsule (KXC) is a new traditional Chinese medicine drug included in "The key science and technology achievements" in the Ninth Five Year Plan of China. KXC has been clinically used for more than 10 years in the treatment of lupus nephritis (LN). However, the underlying role and molecular mechanism of KXC in LN remain unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to explore the efficacy and potential mechanisms of KXC through pharmacological network, in vitro and in vivo studies. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Pharmacological network analysis of KXC treatment in LN was performed using data acquired from the Traditional Chinese Medicine System Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform (TCMSP, https://old.tcmsp-e.com/tcmsp.php) and NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/database). HK-2 cells were chosen as an in vitro model of the tubular immune response by simulation with interferon gamma (IFN-gamma). MRL/lpr mice were used to explore the mechanism of KXC in vivo. Finally, the specific active molecules of KXC were further analyzed by molecular docking. RESULTS: The pharmacological network analysis showed that STAT1 is a key factor in the effects of KXC. In vitro and in vivo experiments confirmed the therapeutic effect of KXC on LN renal function and tubular inflammation. The protective effect of KXC is mediated by STAT1 blockade, which further reduces T-cell infiltration and improves the renal microenvironment in LN. Two main components of KXC, Tripterygium hypoglaucum (H.Lev.) Hutch (Shanhaitang) and Epimedium brevicornu Maxim (Yinyanghuo) could block JAK1-STAT1 activation. Furthermore, we found 8 molecules that could bind to the ATP pocket of JAK1 with high affinities by performing docking analysis. CONCLUSIONS: KXC inhibits renal damage and T-cell infiltration in LN by blocking the JAK1-STAT1 pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：昆明胶囊（KXC）是一种新型中药，被列入中国“九五”计划“重大科技成果”。KXC已在临床上用于治疗狼疮性肾炎（LN）超过10年。然而，KXC在LN中的潜在作用和分子机制仍不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在通过药理学网络、体外和体内研究探讨KXC的疗效和潜在机制。材料与方法：利用从传统中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台（TCMSP，https://old.tcmsp-e.com/tcmsp.php）和NCBI基因表达综合数据库（GEO，https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/database）获取的数据，对KXC治疗LN进行药理学网络分析。选择HK-2细胞作为肾小管免疫反应的体外模型，通过干扰素γ（IFN-gamma）刺激模拟。使用MRL/lpr小鼠探讨KXC在体内的机制。最后，通过分子对接进一步分析KXC的特异性活性分子。结果：药理学网络分析显示，STAT1是KXC作用的关键因子。体外和体内实验证实了KXC对LN肾功能和肾小管炎症的治疗效果。KXC的保护作用通过STAT1阻断介导，进一步减少T细胞浸润并改善LN的肾脏微环境。KXC的两种主要成分，昆明山海棠（Tripterygium hypoglaucum (H.Lev.) Hutch，山海棠）和淫羊藿（Epimedium brevicornu Maxim，淫羊藿），能够阻断JAK1-STAT1激活。此外，通过对接分析，我们发现8个分子能够以高亲和力结合JAK1的ATP口袋。结论：KXC通过阻断JAK1-STAT1通路抑制LN中的肾损伤和T细胞浸润。
